prompts.design: Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept. Revise this existing wolf concept sheet to introduce restrained eldritch corruption for a slightly scary, strange dark fairytale game. Keep EXACT main four-legged left-facing body pose, compact proportions, paws, curled tail, ash brown coat, ivory face and legs, black ink/gouache storybook rendering, parchment layout and detail studies. It must remain recognizably THIS wolf. Make three coordinated subtle but unmistakable anatomical anomalies, not decorations: (1) visible natural amber eye contains TWO narrow black pupils within ONE iris, calm uncanny gaze, no glow; show this clearly in enlarged face study. (2) On the broad near shoulder mane, fur clumps curl concentrically around ONE horizontal almond-shaped closed eyelid embedded naturally in the mane, dark dusty mauve lid with a hairline pale ivory slit suggesting something sleeping underneath; eyelid about natural-eye-to-ear size, legible silhouette motif but only one, NOT many extra eyes, no eyeball popping out, no jewelry or drawn symbol. Fur around it gently follows an impossible inward whorl rather than all pointing backward. Show this detail in lower-right mane study. (3) extend mouth corner slightly too far toward the cheek into a fine black upturned seam, subtle asymmetric knowing smile, retain recognizable muzzle and a few crooked ivory teeth, no torn flesh or gore. Main visual novelty is sleeping eye concealed in shoulder fur and eerily intelligent expression; 85 percent wolf 15 percent eldritch. Muted mauve accent only inside mane eyelid, otherwise unchanged palette. No tentacles, horns, antlers, wings, extra legs, floating symbols, costumes, mushrooms, blood, slime, neon or excessive cosmic spectacle. Keep game-size clarity and restrained cute-creepy storybook look. Match changes consistently across full-body and both closeup studies. No text.
